faq.question: How long does a general cleaning take?
faq.answer: On average 3–6 hours with a team of 2 cleaners for a 60–80 m² apartment. The calculator shows the exact estimate based on area and number of bathrooms.

faq.question: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faq.answer: No, not necessarily. Many clients grant access via an intercom code or a concierge. Payment is due after you personally check the result.

faq.question: Do you bring your own supplies?
faq.answer: Yes, cleaners arrive with professional cleaning products, vacuum cleaners and microfiber cloths. You don't need to buy or prepare anything.

faq.question: How often is general cleaning needed?
faq.answer: Most clients book general cleaning every 1–3 months, with maintenance cleaning once a week or two in between.

faq.question: How soon after renovation can I book a cleaning?
faq.answer: Ideally 1–2 days after the dustiest work is finished, once the bulk of construction dust has settled. This makes the cleaning faster and more effective.

faq.question: How many cleaners and how much time does a post-renovation apartment need?
faq.answer: Usually a team of 2–3 works 5–8 hours for a 60–80 m² apartment — this is the most labor-intensive cleaning type; the calculator will show the exact area-based estimate.

faq.question: Will you remove dried paint stains from the floor?
faq.answer: Fresh and standard residue — yes. Old, stubborn stains are assessed on site: sometimes they need a different cleaning agent, which we'll discuss before starting.

faq.question: How long does a sofa take to dry after cleaning?
faq.answer: On average 4–8 hours at normal humidity. We use professional extraction vacuums that shorten the drying time.

faq.question: Is the chemistry safe for kids and pets?

faq.question: Do you guarantee removal of all stains?
